checklist.name: A
checklist.requirement: every active review carries the Rust-confirmed best amount raw, the measurement flag, the signed PnL raw, the currency and precision, the source, the route identity, the snapshot version and the review time

checklist.name: B
checklist.requirement: no mainnet best_amount_missing and no data_incomplete; a complete review has zero missing values; not_executable keeps its real reason and does not fake a profit

checklist.name: C
checklist.requirement: a measured zero counts as a valid zero; a ladder that never ran, or a Rust result that never arrived, stays a missing value

checklist.name: D

checklist.requirement: re-run the reviews and verify the freshness is inside the 600 second window, and inside the age limit the Review Manager actually enforces for automatic broadcast

observations.note: the stored reviews were written on 2026-11-19, so the 600 second freshness window is NOT met. A fresh review run is a WRITE action, so it needs its own explicit authorisation and was not performed here. The freshness item is therefore UNMEASURED, not passed. Note that a review that satisfies the 600 second observation window can still be refused by the automatic-broadcast gate, which is the tighter of the two thresholds; the L3>0 criterion is decided by the gate, not by the observation window.
